caption: The drawing features a long, flowing dress with a high empire waist and full, balloon-shaped sleeves that gather tightly at the wrists with wide cuffs. The main body of the dress is light beige or champagne in color, decorated with a subtle, repeating diamond and floral pattern rendered in white. The skirt is wide and falls straight to the ankles, with three horizontal bands of solid, shiny fabric in a slightly darker beige at the bottom, creating a textured border. The cuffs match the bands at the hem, featuring the same shiny fabric. The neckline is simple and round. In the upper right, there is a smaller rear view line drawing of the same dress, showing it tied at the back of the neck and repeating the same decorative bands at the bottom hem. The background of the drawing is an off-white or pale tan color. The main illustration is rendered with color and detail, while the rear view is done in faint lines.
title: Dress
